newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Concord expects to raise HK$1.2 bln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Concord expects to raise HK$1.2 bln - paper.

text.p: Pacific Concord Holdings Ltd expects to raise HK$1.2 billion from the proposed spin-off of its infrastructure arm, Concord Land, the Hong Kong Standard said on Wednesday.
The company announced on Monday it had set a preliminary price range of between HK$3.37 to HK$ 4.0 per Concord Land share, representing a discount of 30 to 40 percent to net asset value.
Public subscription would open on October 28, while trading of the shares was scheduled in early November, it said.
The total assets of Concord Land, Pacific Concord's Hong Kong and China property division, would be about HK$7.7 billion.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
